note: PRIMITIVE CATALOG (rebuild-plan Phase B, layer 1). Atomic, fixed-size, corner-anchored bricks distilled from block-library.json + building-blocks.json. Each: fixed px @1280x720, anchor, exit-width (leftover docking slot), internal grid at 9.5pt, token refs, copy-recipe, the code component that renders it (or a TBD gap), and provenance. Structures (structures.json) arrange these into SlideStructure skeletons. Built in batches per component-queue.json.

conventions.bodyText: 9.5pt = 12.7px, Source Sans Pro, --fs-body. The ONLY non-title size (title 14pt=18.7px --fs-title; footnote 7pt=9.3px --fs-footnote; hero KPI --fs-kpi the single large exception).
conventions.labelCaps: small-caps device = 9.5pt bold, letter-spacing .08em (--ls-caps), uppercase, navy. NOT a smaller size.
conventions.contentRegion: x 20->1260 (1240px) . y 84->672 (588px). Primitives are placed by CORNER anchor inside this region and never stretched to fill.
conventions.fills: filled colour (navy/deal-primary) ONLY on KPI tiles, category/section bars, chart series, section dividers. Panels = grey small-caps header band + white body (PanelHeader), never a filled card. Placeholders = dashed grey; target logo = SOLID yellow + 1px RED border + 'COMPANY LOGO' 9.5pt navy caps.
conventions.shadow: house shadow (floating imagery only) = --shadow-house (0 0 9px rgba(0,0,0,.40), i.e. 60% transparency, 5pt blur, 0 offset).

tokenRefs.--tab-width: 22px vertical tab (NB: real renders show 44px — calibrate)

primitives.recipe: The house imagery slot — product photos, site photos, screenshots. Floating images get the house shadow. Real transparent-PNG assets go here; the biggest 'AI tell' is a generic/empty image, so always request real assets.

primitives.name: Colour-coded architectural floorplan panel
primitives.anchor: docked (centre column of a facility gallery)
primitives.exit_width: pairs with text panels left/right
primitives.grid: an architectural floor plan with rooms tinted by function (yellow=offices, green=warehouse/shipping, blue=production/assembly) and labelled; grey small-caps panel header ('GROUND FLOOR')
primitives.recipe: Facility floor plan with function-coloured rooms + labels, under a PanelHeader. Used on HQ / facility-tour slides paired with photo and text panels.
